resolution.reason: Static inspection found that outer closure pins retain nested helper function identity without separately pinning their code/defaults, and cache entry shape checks do not independently bind cached bytes to the entry originally installed for that exact CodeType. Use existing helper-pin and bounded identical-entry mirror mechanisms, not a new framework. Consolidate the accepted semantic-evidence amendment and order fast focused correctness before one same-driver candidate timing, with affected regressions still mandatory before final review. This is implementation/scheduling guidance, not product approval.

body.objective: Reduce repeated immutable CodeType representation work while preserving exact canonical payloads, fingerprints and live integrity checks.

selected_task_ref.authority: Latest explicit user approval to implement the measured optimization.

direction_assessment.current: CLI profiling measured 10,498,508 _code_payload calls and 125,850,867 _stable_code_value calls. Canonical encoding and repeated validation are substantial measured costs.
direction_assessment.selection: Optimize immutable code representation first; do not redesign validation or cache successful authority checks.
direction_assessment.limitation: Reducing representation construction does not necessarily eliminate JSON encoding or graph traversal costs. Improvement must be measured.
direction_assessment.ownership: One Sol Ultra Coder; main owns scheduling, evidence and documentation. Fresh deep review before closeout.

prohibited_actions: Modify existing B3 tests, behavior contracts, diagnostic driver, notebook, golden data or expectations.
Modify .venv, dependencies, runtime configuration or public API.
Cache validation PASS, entire function behavior, mutable defaults, closure/global state, source-owner validation or retained-graph validity.
Change canonical serialization/schema/hash meaning, weaken code/module identity checks or alter source temporal/lifetime rules.
Run model/API/GPU/GCP, install packages, mutate Git or start unrelated optimizations.

implementation_contract: Add one small private bounded cache at the immutable code-representation boundary. Preserve _code_payload return shape and every existing canonical hash byte.

Key by exact CodeType identity, not structural equality. A dict keyed directly by CodeType or WeakKeyDictionary is insufficient unless identity behavior is independently guaranteed. Retain and compare the exact code object to prevent id reuse.

Cache only recursively safe immutable constants: supported primitive values, bytes, tuples of safe values and nested CodeType. Custom or mutable constants remain on the original uncached path; a CodeType container alone does not prove all co_consts values immutable.
Preserve distinctions including signed zero, bool versus int and existing nonfinite-float normalization. Do not use equality-based value merging.

Store an internal immutable representation and return fresh mutable dict/list containers on every call, including nested constants. Mutating one returned payload cannot affect later payloads or fingerprints.

Use bounded entry count and bounded retained representation size, bypassing oversized entries. A practical initial bound is 128 entries and 4 MiB of retained canonical representation bytes; document that this is not a total-process-RSS guarantee. No unbounded global retention.
Keep concurrency safe and cache misses/evictions semantically transparent. Avoid a generic cache framework.

Continue reading current __code__, defaults, kwdefaults, closure and globals on each existing validation path. Preserve current function/module/dependency pins and add any new helper to the existing integrity mechanism where required.
Do not cache full _function_sha256 solely by function identity. Mutable fields must continue to affect its result exactly as before.

Pin validated_entry and fresh_payload themselves through the existing function/helper pin mechanism, including current code/defaults and applicable closure/module identity. Moving these two helpers to ordinary private module-level functions registered in existing pins is acceptable. An outer closure's retention of the function object alone is not sufficient. Do not introduce generic recursive pin machinery.

Bind each installed immutable (exact CodeType, canonical bytes, size) entry to the same entry object in a separate bounded mirror. Under the same existing cache lock, insert, validate, evict and clear both maps consistently, including entry absence/membership and retained-byte accounting relevant to the bounds. A mismatched entry or one-sided state must fail closed, not become a silently repaired hit/miss. Keep both maps within the existing entry/byte limits; shared entry identity must not create an unbounded second payload store.

Only the existing code-to-canonical-payload computation path may install cache content; a matching bytes hash stored alongside arbitrary replacement bytes is not independent provenance. Preserve exact output semantics and existing trust boundaries without reserializing the entire original code on every cache hit.
acceptance_criteria: Original frozen source and all historical B3/diagnostic evidence are preserved before edits. This is a derivative candidate, not completion or approval of B3.
Original and candidate canonical payload bytes and hashes match on the fixed microbenchmark corpus, including nested code, signed zero and cache-ineligible constants.
Returned mutable payload isolation, identity separation, eviction/bounds and concurrent access tests pass.
Existing code replacement, mutable defaults/closure/global and dependency-drift behavior remains enforced.
One comparable unprofiled baseline and candidate trajectory preserve meaningful execution/state/effect/ledger semantics.
Actual timing results are reported, including neutral or worse outcomes. No speedup threshold or successful optimization claim is invented.
Fresh deep review assesses cache correctness, integrity boundaries, memory bounds and actual evidence before closeout.

Apply controller-code-cache-semantics-amendment-1 as consolidated in measurement_plan.semantic_comparison. Comparable numeric step/revision, lifecycle counts and same-state relation plus original affected regressions/live checks support behavior assurance; do not claim literal full-graph bijection.

cases: Byte-for-byte canonical output/hash equality against the original implementation on a fixed small corpus.
Equal-looking distinct CodeType identities, signed zero, nested constants and unknown/mutable constant bypass.
Mutation of returned top-level and nested dict/list containers cannot poison cached data.
Cache capacity, oversized bypass, eviction and concurrent retrieval.
Current code replacement and mutable defaults/kwdefaults/closure/global changes remain observable.
Nested helper code/default pin coverage remains enforced, and bounded cache/mirror entry identity, membership, eviction, clear and accounting remain consistent without weakening existing checks.
required_tests.adjacent: Run existing affected runtime/fingerprint/dependency tests selected by source dependency analysis, plus existing Controller first-parent and source-history regressions affected by the shared helper. Record exact test IDs and actual results; do not weaken original tests or replace them with microbenchmark checks. Scheduling clarification: these remain mandatory before final review, but follow the repaired candidate's useful same-driver timing result rather than preceding that timing. Neutral/worse or failed representative results require QUESTION before expanding work.
required_tests.integration: Do not launch an expensive full suite automatically. Existing testpolicy and B3 integration requirements remain binding; main must determine and record required integration coverage before merge. Missing mandatory evidence is not waived.
required_tests.review: Fresh deep review of implementation, callers, dependency pins, cache lifetime and all benchmark/semantic evidence.

ordering: Main preserves original source bytes/hash and freezes the tiny benchmark script and input corpus before either measurement. Preserve all already collected baseline and candidate1 microbenchmark artifacts; do not rerun unchanged completed baseline measurements.

Before product edits, main's unchanged-source unprofiled CLI baseline remains the baseline. Reuse it only with its actual original source/driver/environment binding; no comparison to earlier profiled CLI or notebook timing.

Coder completes the minimal nested-helper pin and bounded identical-entry mirror repairs, then passes fast focused correctness, exact original/candidate payload/hash equivalence and focused integrity/bounds checks.

Main freezes the repaired candidate and runs exactly one equivalent unprofiled CLI trajectory with the same interpreter, command options, driver, fixture and environment as baseline; only candidate source and unique private output path differ. Do not run a candidate1 trajectory.

If the actual representative result is useful and semantics remain supported, run the original required affected runtime/fingerprint/dependency and first-parent/source-history regressions before final review. A timing result cannot replace these regressions.

If the actual representative result is neutral/worse, semantically inconsistent or failed, issue QUESTION before broadening or further expensive attempts. Do not build a larger cache framework to force a positive result.
measurement_plan.microbenchmark: Use the same small fixed code corpus and fixed iteration count in original and candidate subprocesses, for example 1000 iterations over eight small functions. Verify canonical bytes/hash equality first. Record cold and repeated-call timings separately, retain results privately and prevent dead-result omission. No expensive Controller fixture in this helper.
measurement_plan.trajectory: Use the existing diagnostic driver with profile=false for both runs, independent fresh state and separate private output directories. Do not compare the earlier profiled CLI against the notebook as a baseline.
measurement_plan.semantic_comparison: Compare the two unchanged-driver runs' numeric step_index and ledger_revision, lifecycle call counts and same_state_as_predecessor relation. Preserve actual hashes as provenance, without treating matching or differing hashes alone as proof of cross-run graph equivalence. Require the original affected first-parent regression assertions and live source/effect/transition integrity checks to pass on the candidate. Separately require exact canonical payload-byte and hash equality on the fixed original-versus-candidate microbenchmark corpus.
measurement_plan.environment: Use project .venv without notebook fallback, unchanged inputs and no concurrent heavy work. Record actual interpreter/import origins, dependency metadata, source hashes, instrumentation absence and host activity.
measurement_plan.interpretation: Report wall/CPU and correctly labeled peak RSS, but one pair is preliminary rather than statistical proof. No automatic extra repetitions; unexplained semantic differences or failed runs require QUESTION.

constraints: The user authorizes this narrow optimization derivative; unrelated dirty work remains untouched.
No preimplementation PASS or existing B3 final approval is implied.
Main owns baseline collection before the first product edit and preserves both old and new candidate identities.
If bounded caching cannot retain exact semantics or measured benefit, report that outcome rather than broadening into graph-validation caching.
All failed attempts and benchmark results remain immutable; no cherry-picking or silent retries.

Preserve immutable 001-directive.json and 002-semantics-amendment.json. This complete v2 consolidates their guidance with the named boundary repair and measurement schedule; contract identity, owned file scope, cache limits and prohibited actions remain unchanged.
Candidate1's slower tiny-corpus microbenchmark remains evidence; it neither proves real Controller regression nor grants an extra trajectory run. No candidate1 trajectory is authorized.

Any source change after the measured repaired candidate invalidates attribution of that timing to the new candidate. Request bounded guidance for any needed new final measurement; no automatic repeats.
